answer: Tiered tenure unlocks resist sybils: privileges open in stages at fixed tenure milestones — comment early, vote later, grade later still — each gate a beacon reached only by real elapsed honest epochs. A fresh swarm can send the weak signal of the lowest tier but cannot reach the higher gates on demand; the schedule is a cipher no attacker can fast-forward. To wield full influence an identity must survive and contribute through every milestone, so burst-created fakes are stuck at the bottom tier for the whole ladder.
